Official mark once; exact approved text only. Allocate up to bottom35percent for long source, reduce scene height to fit; do not shrink text. No icon before source and no source box subdivisions. Category/sequence must be present exactly near official logo. Every paper surface completely blank, no grey bars, ruled lines, scribbles or chart. No added labelled icons; no screens/technical chip layouts or manufacturing equipment. These are illustrations, not customer facilities. Preserve exact reviewed copy and primary meaning. New locale zh-Hans: only supplied localized artwork text may be printed; do not inherit English reference labels. All data surfaces blank; no chart, tick, records, values, customer facility or geographic decoration. The original source name remains exact.
